test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Union Budget 2022 - 23 has proposed to reduce the surcharge of cooperative societies from _________ to 7% for those whose income is between Rs. 1 crore and Rs. 10 crore.
solution:
The correct answer is __12%.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The cooperative society is an independent legal person and is subject to taxation.
 
• Interest on securities and income from real estate make up the income of cooperative societies.
 
• Cooperative societies must pay MAT at a rate of 18.5%, while businesses must pay it at a rate of 15%.
 
• According to her, persons with a total annual income of more than Rs 1 crore and up to Rs 10 crore would now pay a 7% surcharge instead of the previous **12%. ​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Union Budget contains details about projected receivables and payables of the government for a particular year.
 
• The Indian government releases the union budget each year, and in **2023** it will do it on February** 1st.**
